threads.body: library instrumentations should not depend on incubating semconv (using it in tests is fine and encouraged)

in library instrumentation we usually we copy the constant from the incubating semconv like in
https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/blob/5611d981d48b69990da752ac97b0b75ccb394292/instrumentation/lettuce/lettuce-5.1/library/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/lettuce/v5_1/OpenTelemetryTracing.java#L50-L51
why do these need to be volatile?
is this actually used? or is it always called before the span is careated?

replies.body: Thanks! the logic is always called before span creation no matter in 5.1.x, 6.5.x or 7.x, I think we can delete it here.

threads.body: perhaps you should pass the output or error message to `finish` and use it as the response and define a `SpanStatusExtractor`
perhaps it should passed to the instrumenter end method instead

The attributes added here aren't part of semantic conventions, perhaps we should ignore them? If there is something interesting then we should add a check for the key, like we have for the attributes above, and store it in the request (or response).
